PART I

Item 1A

ITEM 1A. RISK FACTORS

Our operations and financial results are subject to various risks and uncertainties, including those described below, that could adversely affect our business, financial condition, operating results, cash flows, and stock price. The risks below are not the only ones we face.

Acme Corp | 2024 Form 10-K | 3

PART I

Item 1A

Risks Related to Our Business and Industry

We face intense competition in all areas of our business. If we do not compete effectively, our operating results could be harmed. Our supply chain depends on a limited number of manufacturing partners concentrated in a small number of geographic regions, which exposes us to disruption risk.

Acme Corp | 2024 Form 10-K | 4

PART I

Item 1A

Foreign currency exchange rate fluctuations could adversely affect our financial results, as a substantial portion of our revenue and costs are denominated in currencies other than the U.S. dollar. We do not always hedge our exposure to these fluctuations, which introduces earnings volatility.

Acme Corp | 2024 Form 10-K | 5

ITEM 7. MANAGEMENT'S DISCUSSION AND ANALYSIS OF FINANCIAL CONDITION AND RESULTS OF OPERATIONS

The following discussion should be read together with our consolidated financial statements and related notes. Our fiscal 2024 revenue grew year over year, driven by strong demand across our product lines and disciplined cost management across our operating segments.

Acme Corp | 2024 Form 10-K | 10

PART II

Item 7

Results of Operations

Revenue increased due to higher unit volumes and favorable pricing. Operating margin expanded as we realized efficiencies in our manufacturing and logistics operations, partially offset by continued investment in research and development for next-generation products.

Acme Corp | 2024 Form 10-K | 11

PART II

Item 7

Liquidity and Capital Resources

Our principal sources of liquidity are cash generated from operations and our existing cash and investment balances. We believe our sources of liquidity will be sufficient to meet our operating and capital requirements for at least the next twelve months.

Acme Corp | 2024 Form 10-K | 12

PART II

Item 7

Critical Accounting Estimates

Preparation of our financial statements requires management to make estimates and assumptions that affect reported amounts, including those related to revenue recognition and income taxes.

ITEM 7A. QUANTITATIVE AND QUALITATIVE DISCLOSURES ABOUT MARKET RISK

We are exposed to market risk from changes in interest rates and foreign currency exchange rates in the ordinary course of our business. We use derivative instruments to manage a portion of this exposure, primarily forward contracts on major currency pairs.

Acme Corp | 2024 Form 10-K | 14

PART II

Item 7A

Interest Rate Risk

Our investment portfolio is subject to interest rate risk that could impact our financial position, though we do not currently use derivative financial instruments to hedge these exposures.

Acme Corp | 2024 Form 10-K | 15

Item 7A

Foreign Currency Risk

We transact business in various foreign currencies and are exposed to fluctuations in exchange rates, which could affect our reported financial results upon translation into U.S. dollars.

Acme Corp | 2024 Form 10-K | 16

Item 7A

Credit Risk

We are exposed to credit risk related to our cash equivalents, investments, and accounts receivable, which we manage by monitoring the creditworthiness of our counterparties.
